entries.name: William Durkin

expected.charges: Destruction of government property, mutilation of records, interfering with the Selective Service System, and conspiracy (the May 25, 1969 Chicago draft-record burning).

updates.sentence: Served two years in federal prisons for the Chicago 15 draft-record protest, according to the 2021 Urban Milwaukee remembrance. The actual release date remains unresolved; it is not calculated from this reported duration.

entries.rationale: Bruce Murphy remembrance reports actual two-year service, distinct from sentence length. Preserve June 5, 1970 remand and unknown release; do not adopt conflicting probation length in the obituary.
